pulse.currentFocus: S344 closed a latent unattended-publish path into the public Desk: every downstream guard in news-publish.yml passed when its upstream step was SKIPPED (GitHub coerces an empty output and '0' to the same number), so a slot that drafted nothing ran the art renderer, the full Desk rebuild, the editorial gates and the public-feed cascade — held back from committing only by an ENOENT crash and the cadence gate, either of which a maintainer would have "fixed". Also ended a live homepage voice leak: the changelog's chore filter was dead code and 13 of 24 public sentences came from routine bookkeeping changes. Next: the founder clears the newsletter deploy permission, and picks the Desk cadence lever.
pulse.nextMilestone: The member newsletter sends for the first time — the function deployed, the shared secret set on both sides, and a founder-observed dispatch confirming delivery.
blockers: [ENG/P0] The Monthly Member Newsletter has never sent. Both faults are proven (function not deployed; NEWSLETTER_SECRET absent from Actions) and the repair is written and self-tested in scripts/deploy-member-newsletter.mjs. Execution was refused by the sandbox permission classifier — a permissions gap, not a missing credential. The function has no dry-run, so the first real send must be a founder-observed workflow_dispatch.

[DESK/P1] The Desk has published nothing since 2026-09-04 and public cadence has degraded to periodic. Measured: radar queues 4 topics against 211 rejected, while 4 slots/day against a 14-day novelty window needs ~56 stories. Escalated rather than retuned — cadence and novelty are a published promise (D-S344.5).
[QA/P0] The Phase 0 gate is a human walkthrough and has still not been run.

[SEC/P0] The gateway Supabase service-role slot remains scoped to a different project (ckwtolofoqzrqouqkmvs vs this site fjnpzjjyhnpmunfoycrp) while check-secrets reports READY 2/2. Fix belongs in studio-ops via the S344 Ark cargo (CANON-018).
[AUTH/P0] The Obelisk provider journey remains unobserved. Use --watch, not --live.

now: [S344][UX/P0] The homepage returning-visitor strip had never rendered, and two theme defects were hiding behind that. DONE S344. Found by doing the CANON-053 pixel check on the surface fixed above — it would not render. `returning-visitor-digest.js` loads first (`ambient-loader.js`, both `idle`) and stamps `vs_last_visit_ts` to `now` before `returning-signal-strip.js` reads the same key, so no entry was ever newer than "last visit". Proved with a control blocking only the digest: strip renders, baseline preserved. Same class as the S343 `vs_visit_count` fix, same two files, neighbouring key. Fixed with a one-writer handoff key `vs_prev_visit_ts` (absent = bail, self-heals next visit). Underneath it: `--vs-text` is defined nowhere so every theme used a near-white fallback (invisible on light), and brand gold measured 1.31:1 on cream. Now `--text` plus a light-only `#8a6a00` (4.72:1). 7/7 themes clear WCAG AA on all four elements, measured from painted pixels after two computed-style readings were wrong. See D-S344.6.

[S344][CI/P0] A skipped step read as a successful step, four guards deep. DONE S344. `news-publish.yml` chained on `if: steps.<X>.outputs.status == '0'`; a SKIPPED step writes no output and GitHub coerces `''` and `'0'` to the same number, so the guard passed for a step that never ran. In run `34063581495` the art renderer, Desk rebuild, editorial gates and public-feed cascade all executed on a slot that drafted nothing. Fixed with a non-numeric `ok=yes/no` sentinel across all 7 guards, plus `check-workflow-step-guards.mjs` (10/10 self-test, in `build:check`, 29 workflows clean) run against the pre-fix file as a negative control -- it caught all 7. See D-S344.3.

[S344][CI/P0] `generate-news-art.mjs` crashed with a raw ENOENT stack on the normal dropped slot. DONE S344. Unguarded `readdirSync('.cache/news-drafts')`. Shipped in the SAME change as the guard fix and never alone: this crash was one of only two things preventing an unattended commit of a non-edition. Exit code deliberately unchanged (still non-zero) so promotion stays gated.

[S344][UX/P0] The homepage published CI jargon to returning visitors, and the filter meant to stop it was dead code. DONE S344. `MOVE_VERB[commit.move] || MOVE_VERB[commit.type]` meant `chore: null` was never reached, because chore maps to move `Tended` -> truthy `Refined`. 13 of 24 live sentences were chore commits. Fixed the precedence, added structural `visitorFacing` classification (producer + reader shipped together; absent field = not publishable), stripped `(attempt N)`, and pinned the exact leaked sentence. Feed 24 -> 8, every survivor visitor-visible. Closes [VOICE/P1] from S343. See D-S344.4.

[S344][ENG/P0] FOUNDER: authorise the member-newsletter deploy. The Monthly Member Newsletter has failed 6 consecutive runs and has NEVER sent. Two proven faults: `send-member-newsletter` is not deployed (confirmed against a project-scoped 200 listing 29 functions on `fjnpzjjyhnpmunfoycrp` -- it is absent; `config.toml` has said so since 2026-07-12), and `NEWSLETTER_SECRET` is absent from Actions so the cron sends a bare `Bearer `. Tooling shipped and self-tested: `scripts/deploy-member-newsletter.mjs --status|--deploy|--secret|--verify`, ref pinned (NOT read through the D-S344.1 mismatched slot) and refusing to act if the token cannot see this project. Execution blocked by the sandbox classifier, not by a missing credential. Note: the function has no dry-run -- an authorised POST mails every opted-in member -- so `--verify` deliberately stops at the 404->401 boundary and the first real send should be a founder-observed `workflow_dispatch`. <!-- evidence-open: the script is the TOOL, not the deliverable — the deliverable is a deployed function plus the secret set on both sides, and the newsletter still sends nothing; its own --status reads NOT DEPLOYED / secret ABSENT against a live project-scoped 200 -->

[S344][DESK/P1] ESCALATION: The Desk's cadence promise outruns its queue. Nothing has published since 2026-09-04 and public state has degraded to `periodic`. Measured: radar queues 4 topics against 211 rejected, while 4 slots/day against a 14-day novelty window needs ~56 distinct stories -- novelty held 13 of 14 candidates and the survivor's only source returned HTTP 403. The cadence gate's reds are HONEST (a candidate claiming otherwise was disproved -- see D-S344.5). Not retuned in-session because slot cadence and the novelty window are a published promise about how often the studio speaks (AGENTS.md -> escalate). Founder picks: widen radar yield, shorten novelty, or reduce slots.

[S344][SEC/P0] The Supabase credential mismatch is named at the probe, and the gateway fix is shipped. DONE S344. Root cause is structural, not a bad intake: `loadEnv()` merges every `secrets/*.env` into ONE flat namespace, the studio runs TWO shared Supabase projects, and both want `SUPABASE_URL`/`SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` — so whichever intakes last silently takes the slot. It flipped on 2026-08-17. Fixed here: `probe-supabase-control-plane.mjs` was *diagnosing* `credential-project-mismatch` and then reporting the generic `supabase-rest-probe-failed`, which sends the reader to the provider when the fix is one line in the gateway; the blocker is now named, and the probe also decodes the service-role JWT's own `ref` so a right-URL/wrong-key slot is caught. 16/16 with the historical bug pinned. Gateway half shipped to studio-ops as Ark `01K1S867GM47A2B15C3C840B38` (project-scoped names + surface `lastProbeStatus`). See D-S344.1.

[S344][SEC/P0] FOUNDER: the website's Supabase slot needs its own scoped entry. Until studio-ops adopts scoped names, this repo resolves the sibling project's key and every `supabase.admin` call 401s. The website's own key is still on disk in `secrets/supabase.env.2026-08-17.bak` (project `fjnpzjjyhnpmunfoycrp`). One line in the gateway; not an agent path because it writes a sibling repo's secrets tree (CANON-018). This also blocks the Obelisk ceremony — `verify-provider-journey --watch` gets a non-null key, passes its guard, and fails at the truth reads *after* the passkey flow.
next: [NEXT][SIL][NEWS/AI/P1] Claim-evidence relationship map + agent critique packet. Add stable fact rows and validated factRefs joining factual evidence to stances and visual anchors; publish a per-story public-safe argument map and one-click critique packet with no runtime model spend.

[NEXT][SIL][OBS/P1] Field-vitals freshness closure. Surface observed-through/stale-days, restore a fresh post-S262 RUM window, and bind cohort verdicts to a release SHA so fresh generatedAt can never imply fresh field evidence.
